t.zh: 照片中的细小亮度变化可能掩盖更大范围的结构。用<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>观察平滑的效果：先检查一个亮点对周围的影响，再处理一条明暗分界。本关行、列权重均为 [1/4,1/2,1/4]，图外补零。
t.en: Fine intensity variation in a photograph can obscure larger structures. Use <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref> to examine smoothing: first inspect the effect of one bright point on its surroundings, then process an intensity boundary. Row and column weights are [1/4,1/2,1/4], with zero outside.

desc.zh: 输入一张图，输出用 [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] 横竖各滤一遍的模糊图，图外补 0
desc.en: Takes an image; gives it blurred by [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] across and down, 0 outside

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>减弱细小变化，也会使锐利边界变得模糊。内部常值区域可以保持亮度，但补零边界的邻域条件不同，因此边缘可能变暗。
after.en: <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref> reduces fine variation but also blurs sharp boundaries. Constant interior regions can retain their intensity, while zero-padded boundaries have different neighbourhoods and may darken.

brief.zh: 这张图只有 (1, 1) 是 16：横竖各用 [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] 滤一遍，图外补 0，写出结果。
brief.en: Only (1, 1) of this image is 16: filter across and down with [1/4, 1/2, 1/4], 0 outside, and write the result.

hint.zh: 先横着滤：16 分到左、中、右三格各是多少？
hint.en: Filter across first: how much of the 16 goes to the left, centre and right?

why.zh: 这是只横着滤了一遍：竖直方向也要滤，亮点向上下扩散，中心只剩 4。
why.en: That filters across only: down must be filtered too, spreading the point up and down and leaving 4 at the centre.

brief.zh: 输入一张图：交出横竖各用 [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] 滤过的模糊图。
brief.en: Given an image, give it filtered across and down by [1/4, 1/2, 1/4].

solution: f = filter2D(image, q, h, q, q, h, q)
naive: f = filter2D(image, t, t, t, z, o, z)
